text:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick preflight: marketplace final prelaunch checklist. 72h out. Call out any red flags now.
Priya (Product): Listing copy and SKU mapping done. Need confirmation on launch bundle names (standard, enterprise, dedicated).
Diego (Marketing): Bundles copy looks good. Question: do we feature a combined HW+Service bundle for AcmeEdge? Partner says yes but legal needs signoff.
Claire (Partner): Confirmed partner side: AcmeEdge ok with bundle positioning but want their logo treatment clarified. Sending guidelines.
LegalBot: Flag: must avoid implying joint endorsement. Legal blurb draft posted: "Partner integrations are independent solutions". Needs partner ack.
Eun (Engineering): SI integration tests passing for core APIs. One intermittent failing test around model warmup times on small GPUs in ap-northeast-1. Investigating a mitigation.
Noah (Platform): We should throttle initial marketplace traffic to Dedicated nodes to avoid overwhelm; can set a soft-concurrency limit per partner listing. I can add that to rollout config.
Sam (Partnerships): Who owns partner landing page copy? We need a short explainer + integration checklist + contact CTA.
Priya (Product): I'll draft the landing copy. Eun, can you provide a 3-step integration checklist and sample curl?
Eun (Engineering): Sure. Draft snippet:
```bash
# create tenant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants \\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n -d '{"name":"partner-tenant","region":"ap-northeast-1"}'
```
And note about warmup header: `Prefer-Warmup: true` in requests.
Diego (Marketing): We'll need hero artwork + alternate mobile crop. Tagging design for mobile-first layout.
Claire (Partner): We can provide a 2-column hero asset that matches our brand. Sending link to assets.
LegalBot: Received hero asset check. Also request for privacy/data-processing snippet on marketplace listing. I propose: "Usage data will be processed per Redwood and Partner terms." Approve?
Sam (Partnerships): That text is fine but ask partner for explicit consent on that phrasing. Claire?
Claire (Partner): OK, we approve that phrasing.
Noah (Platform): Ops note: ensure that signing the redirect with the partner-specific token doesn't add extra hops. We'll validate redirect chain in preflight.
Eun (Engineering): Workaround for warmup flakiness: we add a short KV prefetch step in onboarding; small PR ready for staging.
Diego (Marketing): Embargo timing? We shifted to 11am ET Wed to align with partner PR. Confirmed?
Priya (Product): Yes 11am ET Wed. All comms must be queued 2 hours prior.
Sam (Partnerships): Who is owner for partner email cadence and send list? Claire, do you want Redwood to send partner announcements or prefer sending from Acme?
Claire (Partner): Acme prefers joint send but Acme will send partner-facing invite; Redwood can send to our shared joint customers list. We'll sync lists offline.
LegalBot: One more legal check: can we include pricing examples on the public listing? If examples include partner discounts, need both finance approvals.
Priya (Product): Let's include sample pricing with asterisks pointing to T&C. Finance approved prelim numbers.
Noah (Platform): Preflight scheduled 05:30 PT tomorrow. I'll validate provisioning, redirect chain, CDN invalidation, and autoscaler limits.
Eun (Engineering): I'll deploy the warmup fix to staging before preflight.
Diego (Marketing): I'll finalize press list and allocate embargo contacts. Also prepping localized snippets for JP and KR.
Sam (Partnerships): Assets matrix quick: hero (Diego/design), partner logos (Claire + LegalBot signoff), SI guide (Eun), listing screenshots (Priya), pricing table (Product/Finance). Any holes?
Priya (Product): I'll do screenshots and pricing table. Adding finance reviewer: @Lars (Finance) — can you quick peek?
Diego (Marketing): Also need UTM mapping for partner campaign: utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=apac_launch.
Noah (Platform): Ops contingency: if dedicated pool spikes, we'll fallback to hosted variants with capacity-limited responses. Configure fallback policy?
Sam (Partnerships): Yes configure fallback to "hosted-basic" with throttle. Noah, set threshold and add to runbook.
Noah (Platform): Will set threshold to 80% of reserved qps and add a runbook step.
Eun (Engineering): Staging CI green after warmup PR. Rolling to canary now.
Diego (Marketing): Design delivered mobile hero. Uploading to shared drive.
Claire (Partner): Brand kit uploaded. Approve use in hero.
LegalBot: All legal checks cleared except final pricing disclosure language. Need signoff by EOD.
Priya (Product): Noted. I'll chase finance.
OpsBot: Reminder: preflight checklist link: https://docs.redwood/preflight-marketplace (due in 14 hours)
Sam (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. If preflight is green, we move to go/no-go meeting Monday 09:00 PT. Keep this thread for blockers only.
Diego (Marketing): Will post final press schedule here after preflight.
Noah (Platform): Preflight complete: redirect chain OK, CDN invalidated, autoscaler patched. Small spike handled by fallback. Marking as green.
Eun (Engineering): Integration warmup fix working in canary. Logging follow-up task RW-342 for telemetry.
Priya (Product): Pricing disclosure signed off by finance. All clear.
Sam (Partnerships): All green. Final go/no-go on Mon 09:00 PT. Thanks folks! :tada:
